decision.re_review_reason: Any future choice needs a fresh full review of the exact captured tree, license evidence, frontmatter receipts for both targets, static findings, and value/function comparison; this survey does not authorize runtime promotion.
decision.next_safe_option: Keep latest quarantined only or conduct a separately approved source-preserving adaptation/review; do not rename or weaken the rejected tree.
